metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.0 · 2003 · Mother's Elling
metas.description: In this prequel to Elling (2001), Elling, a slightly autistic, but opinionated young man, lives with his aging mother who is worried what he'll do without her. She decides to take him on a trip to Spain to see new things.
